input: Did Apple's services business grow faster than its products business in fiscal year 2025? Support with figures.
final_output: Yes, Apple's Services business grew faster than its Products business in fiscal 2025. Services gross margin increased by $11,264 million (from $71,050 million in 2024 to $82,314 million in 2025), representing a 15.9% growth rate. In comparison, Products gross margin increased by $3,254 million (from $109,633 million in 2024 to $112,887 million in 2025), representing a 3.0% growth rate. Services growth was driven by higher net sales from advertising, the App Store and cloud services.
